title: KRIS-Bench: Benchmarking Next-Level Intelligent Image Editing Models
findings: Leading models (e.g., GPT-4o, Gemini 2.0, Doubao) generally performed well on the 'Humanities' task, which included an instance requiring knowledge of Christianity (identifying its most representative figure). This performance on cultural knowledge tasks was stronger compared to their performance on tasks requiring scientific reasoning.
